chapters.label: 01 · Home
chapters.head: What needs you comes first.
chapters.sub: Bills, fines and requests from every entity, at the top of Home. Pay all appears when two or more are due.

chapters.label: 02 · Widgets
chapters.head: Your city, live on Home.
chapters.sub: Parking, Salik, prayer times and the metro. Widgets you choose, updating all day.

chapters.label: 03 · Receipts
chapters.head: Paid, then one tap to rate it.
chapters.sub: Every receipt asks how it went. The answer goes to the entity and the Happiness Meter, and never blocks a task.

chapters.label: 04 · Search
chapters.head: Ask in your own words.
chapters.sub: Search grows from the bottom, answers simple questions and knows local words.

chapters.label: 05 · Activity
chapters.head: Always know what’s next.
chapters.sub: Every request, step by step. When it’s your turn, the action is right there.

chapters.label: 06 · Your Home
chapters.head: Home is yours to arrange.
chapters.sub: Pull past the end to add widgets. Nothing appears or disappears on its own.
